title: hoptell team file
description: A team for hoptell team up: the lead session, its members, their CLIs, tasks and limits. Checked by lib/teams.js, which also refuses what a schema cannot say: member names that do not start with the lead's first part and "-", a name used twice, an agy implementer, owns or folder on a reviewer, and two implementers whose owns may name the same file (a missing owns overlaps everything). Relative paths are from the team file's folder; "~/" is the home folder.

team.description: Used in the branch names team/<team>/<member> and the role <role>,<team>.

repo.description: The git repository the implementers work on.

base.description: The commit every implementer's worktree starts from (one base for the team).

worktrees.description: The folder for the worktrees; by default <repo>-wt next to the repository. Neither inside the repository nor containing it.

lead.description: The lead session's peer name (start the lead with HOPTELL_NAME set to it). Its part before the first "-" is the members' prefix.

idleMinutes.description: Reviewers with no output and no waiting message this long are ended; implementers never are.

lifetimeMinutes.description: The default lifetime of each member, from its start.

model.description: Over the owner's preset, the shipped preset and the CLI's own configuration.

task.description: The member's task file (at most 32 KiB), served by read_task.

owns.description: Implementers only: the globs the member may change.

template.description: The role template; by default the role.

folder.description: Implementers only: the worktree's folder name.
